units.source_text: 大女公子预先吩咐侍女，叫她们留在帘内近旁。

en.t: The elder princess had instructed her attendants beforehand to stay nearby inside the curtain.

units.source_text: 但侍女们想：“不应该如此疏远他。”

en.t: But the attendants thought, "She should not keep him at such a distance."

units.source_text: 都不肯在这里守备。

en.t: None of them was willing to remain there on guard.

units.source_text: 大家退出外面，倚靠在各处睡觉了，佛前的灯火也无人来剔亮。

en.t: They all withdrew outside and fell asleep leaning here and there, and no one came to trim the lamp before the Buddha.

units.source_text: 大女公子狼狈起来，低声呼唤侍女，然而唤不醒。

en.t: The elder princess grew flustered and called softly to the attendants, but she could not wake them.

units.source_text: 她对薰君说：“我心情不佳，颇感疲乏，让我休息一下，天亮时候再来和你晤谈。”

en.t: She said to Lord Kaoru, "I am not feeling well and am rather tired. Let me rest a little, and at daybreak I will come speak with you again."

units.source_text: 便起身回内室去。

en.t: Then she rose and went back toward the inner room.

units.source_text: 薰君答道：“我跋涉山路远道而来，比你更加疲乏，但如此和你谈谈，听你说说，便可慰我劳顿。

en.t: Lord Kaoru replied, "I have traveled a long way over mountain roads and am even more weary than you, but speaking with you like this and listening to you eases my fatigue.

units.source_text: 你若舍弃了我，回内室去，教我好寂寞啊！”

en.t: If you abandon me and go back to the inner room, how lonely you will make me feel!"

units.source_text: 他就把屏风稍稍推开，钻进佛堂里来。

en.t: He then pushed the screen slightly open and slipped into the Buddhist hall.

units.source_text: 大女公子半个身子已经进入内室，却被薰君拉住了。

en.t: The elder princess already had half her body inside the inner room, but Lord Kaoru caught hold of her.

units.source_text: 大女公子又是懊恼，又是忧惧，斥道：“你所谓‘毫无隔阂’，原来是如此么？

en.t: The elder princess was both vexed and frightened, and rebuked him, "So this is what you mean by having no barrier between us?

units.source_text: 真是荒唐！”

en.t: How outrageous!"

units.source_text: 那娇嗔之相更加可爱。

en.t: Her charmingly indignant expression made her seem all the more lovely.

units.source_text: 薰君答道：“你全然不了解我这毫无隔阂的心，所以我想请你了解。

en.t: Lord Kaoru replied, "You do not understand at all this open heart of mine, and that is why I want you to understand it.

units.source_text: 你说‘荒唐’，是否担心我将有非礼之行？

en.t: When you call it outrageous, are you afraid that I will behave improperly?

units.source_text: 我可在佛前立誓。

en.t: I can swear an oath before the Buddha.

units.source_text: 你一点也不要惧怕！

en.t: You must not be afraid in the least.

units.source_text: 我早就打定主意：决不使你伤心。

en.t: I resolved long ago that I would never make you grieve.

units.source_text: 外人料不到我会如此坚贞，但我决心终身做个与众不同的人。

en.t: People outside would never imagine that I could be so steadfast, but I have resolved to live my whole life as someone unlike the rest.
